completion:
Identify the areas with the greatest losses.
3. Create "Miscellaneous Income" entries which mitigate these losses in the ledger.
4. Shift expenses to future accounting periods.
5. Overstate revenues in the current period.
6. Defer recognition of expenses.
7. Recognize revenue prematurely.
8. Manipulate inventory numbers to show a higher value.

10. Set up fictitious transactions or "round-trip" transactions that cancel each other out.
11. Capitalize expenses that should be expensed in the period incurred.

13. Abuse reserve accounts by under-reserving or over-reserving for future liabilities.
